courtyard.Name: Castle Courtyard
courtyard.Description: You are standing on a paved courtyard. Towering castle walls rise above you.

throne room.Name: Throne Room
throne room.Description: A magnificent hall lit by many candlesticks.

armory.Name: Armory
armory.Description: A room filled with empty suits of armor. You see some old rags on the floor.

barracks.Name: Soldiers' Barracks
barracks.Description: A row of simple wooden bunks. A few torches lie unlit in the corner.

training grounds.Name: Training Grounds
training grounds.Description: An open area. Wild herbs grow near the wooden fencing.

kitchen.Name: Castle Kitchen
kitchen.Description: A hot room. There is a large barrel of fresh spring water here.

cellar.Name: Wine Cellar
cellar.Description: A dark, chilly basement. Mushrooms and strange herbs grow in the damp corners.

library.Name: Grand Library
library.Description: Shelves packed with books. You see scraps of parchment and cloth used as bookmarks.

wizard tower.Name: Wizard's Tower
wizard tower.Description: The air is thick with magic. Vials of strange liquids are scattered around.

dungeon.Name: Dark Dungeon
dungeon.Description: A damp prison. You find some old rags (cloth) discarded in a cell.

NPCs.prisoner: Can you spare some water, sir?
